Find your marginal rate in two steps. Multiply your monthly salary before tax by 12, then find the step it lands in (2026/27 tax year, March 2026 to February 2027): up to R245,100 a year, 18%; up to R383,100, 26%; up to R530,200, 31%. That's roughly the share of your bonus that goes to tax before you see it.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
